title: SEO Services Lahore: Google and AI Search (GEO) | 22 Signals
description: SEO services Lahore businesses use to show up on Google Maps, in Urdu and English search, and in ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini answers. Monthly reports.
h1: SEO services Lahore businesses use to be found on Google and in AI answers
intro: Our SEO services help established Lahore businesses get found when customers search, whether they type in English, Urdu or Roman Urdu, open Google Maps or ask an AI assistant. We fix the technical basics, build local SEO and your Google Business Profile, write answer-first pages and report every month on enquiries, not just rankings.

sections.h: How people in Lahore search now
p: A customer looking for a dentist in DHA, a caterer for a mehndi or a fabric supplier for a startup brand does three things. They search on Google, often with "near me" or a neighbourhood name. They check the map pack, the photos and the reviews. And more and more of them ask ChatGPT or Gemini for a shortlist. If you are missing from any of the three, you are missing from the decision.

On top of that, the same search is typed several ways: English, Urdu script and Roman Urdu, with spellings that vary from person to person. Good SEO in this city starts with knowing all of those versions.

list: Technical SEO: speed on mobile data, crawl errors, indexing, structured data and clean site architecture.
Local SEO and Google Business Profile: categories, services, photos, posts and accurate details for each branch.

How the business is described across the web: directories, social profiles, marketplaces and press, all saying the same thing.

Monthly reporting tied to calls, WhatsApp clicks, bookings and sales.

p: Generative engine optimisation, or GEO, is the work of making your business easy for AI assistants to understand and recommend. When someone asks for the best bridal makeup artists in Lahore or a reliable towel manufacturer in Pakistan, the assistant pulls from pages and mentions it trusts. We write clear, factual pages, keep your details consistent everywhere and earn mentions on sites the assistants read, so you show up in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Google AI Overview answers more often.

Right now, 10 of the businesses we work with sit in Google's top five for their main searches and show up in ChatGPT's answers. The method behind it is the one we use for Lahore clients: accurate pages, details that match everywhere and steady monthly content, checked before it goes live.

sections.h: A Lahore case: beauty salon and studio
p: For a Lahore beauty salon and studio we rebuilt the website, set up local SEO and the Google Business Profile, and paired it with Google Ads. The pages were rewritten around the treatments people actually search for and the profile was completed with its services, photos and categories. The aim was simple: when someone nearby searches for a treatment, the salon appears and the booking reaches the front desk.

sections.h: Branches, reviews and the details Google checks
p: Many Lahore businesses grow branch by branch: a second salon in DHA, a third outlet in Johar Town, a factory outlet on the edge of the city. Each one needs its own Google Business Profile, its own page on your site and the same name, address and phone wherever it is listed. When those details drift, Google and AI assistants lose confidence and show someone else.

Reviews matter just as much. We set up a simple way for happy customers to leave one, usually a WhatsApp message after the visit, and a routine for replying to every review, good or bad, in the language it was written in.

Talk: your services, branches and the customers worth most to you. Plan: an audit, keyword map and a written 90-day plan. Build: the technical fixes, profile work and first pages. Grow: monthly content, mentions and reporting, with the next month's work agreed before it starts.

We run SEO for Lahore businesses through shared access to your site, Google Business Profile, analytics and Search Console. The monthly review is booked at a time that suits your team. faqs.q: What do your SEO services cover?
faqs.a: Technical fixes, local SEO and Google Business Profile for each branch, keyword research in English, Urdu and Roman Urdu, answer-first content, consistent business details across the web, earned outside mentions and a monthly report. We also cover how you appear in AI assistants. The mix depends on your site and competition.

faqs.q: How long do SEO services take to work in Lahore?
faqs.a: Local profile fixes and technical repairs often show movement first. New pages need time to settle and rank, and competitive searches longer. We set expectations in the first plan and report every month on enquiries as well as positions, so progress is clear.

faqs.q: Should we target Urdu or English searches?
faqs.a: Usually both. Many Lahore customers search in English for services and in Roman Urdu or Urdu for everyday needs. We check the volume and intent of each version for your business, then decide which pages need Urdu content and which only need the Roman Urdu terms worked into English pages.

faqs.q: What is GEO and does a Lahore business need it?
faqs.a: GEO means making your business easy for AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini to describe and recommend. More customers ask these tools for shortlists, so yes, it matters. Most of the work overlaps with good SEO: clear pages, consistent details across the web and genuine outside mentions.

faqs.q: Can you help us rank on Google Maps in Gulberg or DHA?
faqs.a: Yes. Map rankings depend on distance, relevance and prominence. We cannot move your premises, but we can make your profile complete and accurate, add the right categories and services, build location pages, keep details consistent and help you collect genuine reviews within Google's rules.

No. Bought links break Google's guidelines and can harm rankings. We earn mentions through useful content, industry and local directories that matter, partnerships and press, and we report every link we secure. Bought links can look like progress for a month and then become a liability, so we would rather build fewer, real ones that last.

faqs.q: Do you need to be in Lahore to do our SEO?
faqs.a: No. SEO is done online, so we work with Lahore clients through shared access and a written plan. We may ask you for photos of your premises or team, or arrange a shoot when the project needs it, since real images help both your Google profile and your pages.
